facts.fact: 骷髅为什么不打架：没有胆子（也没有内脏），guts 双关
facts.anchor: Why don’t skeletons fight each other? They don’t have the guts.

facts.fact: 叙述者反驳室友说房子闹鬼：我在这儿住了四百年，从没见过鬼——他自己就是鬼
facts.anchor: My housemates keep saying our house is haunted. That’s ridiculous – I’ve lived here for 400 years and never seen a ghost.

facts.fact: 德古拉爱咬人脖子，因为他是“脖子浪漫者”，谐音 necromancer（死灵法师）
近视的鬼戴什么？spooktacles，spectacles（眼镜）与 spook 的合成
facts.anchor: What do short-sighted ghosts wear? Spooktacles!

facts.fact: 恶魔和食尸鬼总在一起，因为“恶魔是食尸鬼最好的朋友”，仿“狗是人类最好的朋友”＋ghoul／girl 谐音
facts.anchor: Because demons are a ghoul’s best friend!

facts.fact: 我以前是狼人，现在好了——句尾的 now 被拉成狼嚎
facts.anchor: I used to be a werewolf but I’m alright noooooooooooooooow.
What do you call a ghost chicken? A poultrygeist.

facts.fact: 吸血鬼写信开头是“Tomb it may concern”，仿 To whom it may concern，tomb（坟墓）
facts.anchor: How do vampires begin letters? ‘Tomb it may concern …’

facts.fact: 别跟死神打枕头仗：你承受不起“死神靠垫”，谐音 repercussions（后果）
facts.anchor: You’re not prepared for the reaper cushions.

facts.fact: 满身血的蝙蝠带同伴飞到树前，问“看见那根路灯柱了吗”，众蝠点头，它说“我没看见”——血是自己撞的
facts.anchor: He flies off, face still covered in blood, and the rest of the bats excitedly follow him across the forest. He lands in a tree and says, ‘Do you see that lamp post?’ The other bats nod hungrily. ‘Well, I didn’t.’
